title: Research: prove the dense P112 actual-reader floor
body:
## Summary

Prove that any finite dense query list in the span of two literal PR3370 indicators costs at least `2 max(m_A,m_B)` under the actual complete-plane rectangular reader tariff, over every coefficient field. Readers may cancel outside the target. Two queries attain the bound for the two halves of one group over fields with more than two elements. Attainment for different groups is unclaimed.

```text
Every target port needs at least two active dense-query readers.
Each reader pays for all target-group planes it touches.
Summing for each group gives total cost >= 2 max(m_A,m_B).
```

PR3429's at-most-three-direction theorem leaves longer lists open. This closes the dense case with arbitrary direction count. Mixed axis/nonaxis longer lists and external query dimensions remain open. PR3383 bills query self-Gram rank for whole-K spanning lists. Its conclusion does not transfer to actual-reader rank. The proof compares these exact scopes, and the separate checker gives a literal self-cost 8/actual-cost 2 term to show why.

The isolated package contains the self-contained proof, source pins, unchanged retained attributed PR3370 certificate, exact receipt, two elimination implementations and failure controls. Disjoint replacements of the stated kind cannot lower 224. No native execution bill, supplier admission, new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3429 covers at most three projective directions and documents a limitation of its binary-map method at four directions.
- **After:** The direct two-cover proof handles any finite dense list. Both implementations pass all 496 literal pairs and 80,240 reader-support subsets. The primary checks 96 exact rational operators with 2,4,7 directions and 16 same-group attaining examples. The separate checker tests 118,285 finite-field coefficient tuples and 4,854 axis deliveries. Five behavioral groups include four optimized CLI corruptions and proportional-query splitting.

```sh
python3.12 -I -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/p112-dense-query-reader-floor
```

Registered CPython 3.12.15 and optimized CPython 3.15.0 replay pass, as do Ruff checks/formatting, exact committed-byte/source-history checks and all three scripts in normal and optimized Python on the committed Git-free export. Export bytes stay unchanged. Canonical main and submission refresh are `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c`, priority revision 6.

Credit Tekalign/PR3370, Nick Petalas/PR3429/PR3398/PR3383, Philippe Van Velzen, PR3345, Matarener/Mark/PR3335 and the retained E8/P112/native/compiler/supplier lineage. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. Hosted CI, full selected cold replay, physical execution, restoration, frames, ownership, stock, precision, all-size and outer-transfer obligations are separate.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

Adds only `research/p112-dense-query-reader-floor/`; selected records, shared verifiers and frozen predecessors are unchanged.
